purpose: Separate offline diagnosis of retained v1 caption responses; this is not a new production acceptance.
limitations: Provider transcript is reported by the speech generator, not independent listening.
Independent ASR and its error rates are advisory; none establishes actual omissions, fluency or meaning.
Forced alignment is not itself an omission detector.
No hypothetical timestamp rounding is applied to the preserved v1 response or to a caption artifact.
The original production authority remains expired and actual web production remains closed at 0/78 captions.

provenance.originalSpeechRequests: All 78 complete title-and-body requests verified against their historical producing job, input hash, receipt, PCM identity and final MP3 bytes.
provenance.providerTranscript: Actual Realtime response.output_audio_transcript.done, checked against response.done output content. No request-text fallback.
provenance.independentTranscription: Previously retained independent recognition; expected wording was not included in its prompt. All comparisons remain advisory.
provenance.timestampResponses: Canonical observation and receipt digests, raw response length/hash and exact audio/prompt bindings verified offline. Original keyed signatures were not newly reverified by this analysis.
provenance.exportCorrection: A first read-only diagnostic export hashed pg Date objects before JSON serialization. Its original bytes and failure record were retained; a second read-only export normalized transport dates before hashing and its saved envelope was reverified.

candidateResearch.status: Researched; no alignment calls or qualification results.
